summary: Worlds created with seed "REDApRES" (0) crash when trying to load new 1.18 mountain biomes / java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "dfw.a(double, double, double)" because "this.a" is null
description: Basically the title. This doesn t affect any cave biomes. To recreate this you just have to enter "REDApRES" into the seed field and create a new world. After that you can locate and tp/walk to any of the new mountain biomes except Meadow and the world will crash. I tried this on a server and the error was "java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "dfw.a(double, double, double)" because "this.a" is null" and the server closed with error code "255". I understand that technically seed "0" isn t even supposed to be entered but it have worked with all previous versions so I think this crash counts as a bug. My guess is that this new mountain generation is completely based on the raw seed so there probably won t be any fix for this bug but I am still reporting it because I often use it and I got hope. Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world and enter "REDApRES" into the seed field.
3. Complete the world creation process.
4. Locate a new mountain biome (except Meadow) in the world.
5. Use the `/tp` command or walk to the mountain biome.
6. Observe that the game crashes with a "java.lang.NullPointerException" error.
Observed Behavior: Worlds created with the seed "REDApRES" (0) experience crashes when attempting to load new mountain biomes introduced in version 1.18, specifically resulting in a java.lang.NullPointerException, which indicates an attempt to invoke a method on a null object. This issue does not affect cave biomes. To replicate the problem, players can enter "REDApRES" as the seed and create a new world. After generating the world, players can either teleport or walk to any of the new mountain biomes, except for the Meadow biome, at which point the game will crash. On a server, the same error appears, leading to a server closure with error code 255. While it is noted that technically seed "0" should not be entered, it has functioned correctly in previous versions, suggesting that this crash qualifies as a bug. The underlying issue may stem from the new mountain generation being heavily reliant on the raw seed, which raises concerns about the feasibility of a fix. Despite these challenges, the reporting player frequently utilizes this seed and remains hopeful for a resolution. The relevant stack trace indicates an exception during chunk generation, pinpointing the source of the error to specific lines in the code where the null reference occurs.
Expected Behavior: When using the seed "REDApRES" (0) to create a new world, players should be able to explore and load new 1.18 mountain biomes without experiencing any crashes. Upon reaching any of the new mountain biomes, except for Meadow, the game should generate the terrain smoothly and allow players to interact with the environment without encountering a NullPointerException error. This behavior should remain consistent across all game modes and server environments.
